# contribution degree

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:contributionDegree`](gmeow-contributionDegree.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/contributionDegree>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The degree or weight of the contribution — lead, equal, or supporting. Optional (≤1 per [`Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md)). A value from the open [`gmeow:ContributionDegree`](../classes/gmeow-ContributionDegree.md) vocabulary.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use inside a [`gmeow:Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) to weight a credit as lead, equal, or supporting — for credit ordering and first-author/lead-maintainer distinctions.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it to rank contributors as a privileged winner ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9) — competing orderings are standpoint-indexed) and omit it entirely when degree is unknown; it is optional.

### How to use

- Point the [`Contribution`](../classes/gmeow-Contribution.md) at one [`gmeow:ContributionDegree`](../classes/gmeow-ContributionDegree.md) individual; leave it absent rather than guessing a degree, and carry disputed orderings on the statement layer.

- ex:c1 [`gmeow:contributionDegree`](gmeow-contributionDegree.md) [`gmeow:degreeLead`](../individuals/gmeow-degreeLead.md).
